box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0px; text-align: left;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: normal;

ul.style: box-sizing: border-box ; margin: 0px auto 1.7rem ; padding: 0px 0px 0px 2.5rem ; width: 745px ; color: rgb(255 , 255 , 255) ; font-family: , , , "blinkmacsystemfont" , "segoe ui" , "roboto" , "helvetica neue" , "helvetica" , "arial" , sans-serif ; font-size: 16px ; background-color: rgb(4 , 6 , 6)

li.style: box-sizing: border-box ; margin: 0px 0px 0.8rem ; padding: 0px 0px 0px 4px ; list-style: outside none disc

ul.li:
Terminating targets
: Terminating targets perform an action which terminates evaluation within the chain and returns control to the
netfilter
hook. Depending on the return value provided, the hook might drop the packet or allow the packet to continue to the next stage of processing.

li.style: box-sizing: border-box ; margin: 0px 0px 0.8rem ; padding: 0px 0px 0px 4px ; list-style: outside none disc

ul.li:
Non-terminating targets
: Non-terminating targets perform an action and continue evaluation within the chain. Although each chain must eventually pass back a final terminating decision, any number of non-terminating targets can be executed beforehand.

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: normal;

dt.style: font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 0.1em; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

dd.style: margin-left: 1.6em; margin-bottom: 0.1em; margin-right: 0px; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

div.dd:
When loaded, registers a hook that will be called before any other Netfilter hook. It provides a table called
raw
that can be used to filter packets before they reach more memory-demanding operations such as Connection Tracking.

dt.style: font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 0.1em; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

dd.style: margin-left: 1.6em; margin-bottom: 0.1em; margin-right: 0px; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

div.dd:
Registers a hook and
mangle
table to run after Connection Tracking (see below) (but still before any other table), so that modifications can be made to the packet. This enables additional modifications by rules that follow, such as NAT or further filtering.

dt.style: font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 0.1em; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

dd.style: margin-left: 1.6em; margin-bottom: 0.1em; margin-right: 0px; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

div.dd:
Registers two hooks: Destination Network Address Translation-based transformations ("DNAT") are applied before the filter hook, Source Network Address Translation-based transformations ("SNAT") are applied afterwards. The
network address translation
table (or "nat") that is made available to iptables is merely a "configuration database" for
NAT
mappings only, and not intended for filtering of any kind.

dt.style: font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 0.1em; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

dd.style: margin-left: 1.6em; margin-bottom: 0.1em; margin-right: 0px; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

div.dd:
Registers the
filter
table, used for general-purpose filtering (firewalling).

dt.style: font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 0.1em; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

dd.style: margin-left: 1.6em; margin-bottom: 0.1em; margin-right: 0px; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

div.dd:
Used for Mandatory Access Control (MAC) networking rules, such as those enabled by the
SECMARK
and
CONNSECMARK
targets. (These so-called "targets" refer to Security-Enhanced Linux markers.) Mandatory Access Control is implemented by Linux Security Modules such as SELinux. The security table is called following the call of the filter table, allowing any Discretionary Access Control (DAC) rules in the filter table to take effect before any MAC rules. This table provides the following built-in chains:
INPUT
(for packets coming into the computer itself),
OUTPUT
(for altering locally-generated packets before routing), and
FORWARD
(for altering packets being routed through the computer).

p.span: 前面已经分别讨论了 table 和 chain，接下来看每个 table 里各有哪些 chain。另外，我 们还将讨论注册到同一 hook 的不同 chain 的优先级问题。例如，如果三个 table 都有

p.span: chain，那应该按照什么顺序调用它们呢？

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; text-align: left; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;
p.span: 下面的表格展示了 table 和 chain 的关系。横向是 table， 纵向是 chain，Y 表示 这个 table 里面有这个 chain。例如，第二行表示

code.style: box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SourceCodePro, Consolas, Courier, NotoSansSC; text-align: left; vertical-align: initial; padding: 0.6px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgb(241, 241, 241); font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--code-block-bg-color); margin: 0px 2px;

p.span: table 有

code.style: box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SourceCodePro, Consolas, Courier, NotoSansSC; text-align: left; vertical-align: initial; padding: 0.6px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgb(241, 241, 241); font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--code-block-bg-color); margin: 0px 2px;

p.span: 和

code.style: box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SourceCodePro, Consolas, Courier, NotoSansSC; text-align: left; vertical-align: initial; padding: 0.6px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgb(241, 241, 241); font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--code-block-bg-color); margin: 0px 2px;

p.span: 两 个 chain。具体到每列，从上倒下的顺序就是 netfilter hook 触发的时候，（对应 table 的）chain 被调用的顺序。

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; text-align: left; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;
p.span: 有几点需要说明一下。在下面的图中，

code.style: box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SourceCodePro, Consolas, Courier, NotoSansSC; text-align: left; vertical-align: initial; padding: 0.6px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgb(241, 241, 241); font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--code-block-bg-color); margin: 0px 2px;

p.span: table 被细分成了

code.style: box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SourceCodePro, Consolas, Courier, NotoSansSC; text-align: left; vertical-align: initial; padding: 0.6px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgb(241, 241, 241); font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--code-block-bg-color); margin: 0px 2px;

p.span: （修改目的地址） 和

code.style: box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SourceCodePro, Consolas, Courier, NotoSansSC; text-align: left; vertical-align: initial; padding: 0.6px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgb(241, 241, 241); font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--code-block-bg-color); margin: 0px 2px;

p.span: （修改源地址），以更方便地展示他们的优先级。另外，我们添加了路由决策点 和连接跟踪点，以使得整个过程更完整全面：

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; text-align: left; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;
box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px;

span.strong: 当一个包触发 netfilter hook 时，处理过程将沿着列从上向下执行

p.span: 。 触发哪个 hook（列）和包的方向（ingress/egress）、路由判断、过滤条件等相关。

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px;
box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px;

span.font: 特定事件会导致 table 的 chain 被跳过。例如，只有每个连接的第一个包会去匹配 NAT 规则，对这个包的动作会应用于此连接后面的所有包。到这个连接的应答包会被自动应用反 方向的 NAT 规则。

switch.text: 🔗前面已经分别讨论了 table 和 chain，接下来看每个 table 里各有哪些 chain。另外，我 们还将讨论注册到同一 hook 的不同 chain 的优先级问题。例如，如果三个 table 都有 PRETOUTING chain，那应该按照什么顺序调用它们呢？...

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 748px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1887px; margin-left: 1432px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0px; text-align: left;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: normal;

p.style: text-align: center; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5;
box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5; color: rgb(77, 91, 124); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;

div.p:
As a packet triggers a
netfilter
hook, the associated chains will be processed as they are listed in the table above from top-to-bottom. The hooks (columns) that a packet will trigger depend on whether it is an incoming or outgoing packet, the routing decisions that are made, and whether the packet passes filtering criteria.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5; color: rgb(77, 91, 124); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;

div.p:
Certain events will cause a table’s chain to be skipped during processing. For instance, only the first packet in a connection will be evaluated against the NAT rules. Any
nat
decisions made for the first packet will be applied to all subsequent packets in the connection without additional evaluation. Responses to NAT’ed connections will automatically have the reverse NAT rules applied to route correctly.

switch.text: 🔗As a packet triggers a netfilter hook, the associated chains will be processed as they are listed in the table above from top...

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 698px; height: 1px; padding-top: 477px; margin-left: 1232px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0px; text-align: left;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: normal;

h2.style: text-align: center; box-sizing: border-box; break-after: avoid-page; break-inside: avoid; orphans: 4; font-size: 1.5em; margin-top: 0.83em; margin-bottom: 0.83em; display: block; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;

box-sizing: border-box; break-after: avoid-page; break-inside: avoid; orphans: 4; font-size: 1.5em; margin-top: 0.83em; margin-bottom: 0.83em; display: block; font-weight: bold; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: start; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; text-align: left; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;
p.span: 包符合某种规则的条件而触发的动作（action）叫做目标（target）。目标分为两种类型：

ul.style: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0.5rem 0px; padding-left: 30px; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0px 0px 0.5rem; position: relative; text-align: left;
p.span: （terminating targets）：这种 target 会终止 chain 的匹配，将控制权 转移回 netfilter hook。根据返回值的不同，hook 或者将包丢弃，或者允许包进行下一 阶段的处理

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0px 0px 0.5rem; position: relative; text-align: left;
p.span: （non-terminating targets）：非终止目标执行动作，然后继续 chain 的执行。虽然每个 chain 最终都会回到一个终止目标，但是在这之前，可以执行任意多 个非终止目标

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; text-align: left; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;
p.span: 每个规则可以跳转到哪个 target 依上下文而定，例如，table 和 chain 可能会设置 target 可用或不可用。规则里激活的 extensions 和匹配条件也影响 target 的可用性。

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; text-align: left; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;

box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; text-align: left; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;

h1.style: box-sizing: border-box; break-after: avoid-page; break-inside: avoid; orphans: 4; font-size: 1.8em; margin-top: 0.67em; margin-bottom: 0.67em; line-height: 31.68px; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC;
h1.span: 7 跳转到用户自定义 chain

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px;
p.span: 这里要介绍一种特殊的非终止目标：跳转目标（jump target）。jump target 是跳转到其 他 chain 继续处理的动作。我们已经讨论了很多内置的 chain，它们和调用它们的 netfilter hook 紧密联系在一起。然而，iptables 也支持管理员创建他们自己的用于管理 目的的 chain。

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px;
p.span: 向用户自定义 chain 添加规则和向内置的 chain 添加规则的方式是相同的。不同的地方在于，

span.strong: 用户定义的 chain 只能通过从另一个规则跳转（jump）到它，因为它们没有注册到 netfilter hook

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px;
p.span: 用户定义的 chain 可以看作是对调用它的 chain 的扩展。例如，用户定义的 chain 在结 束的时候，可以返回 netfilter hook，也可以继续跳转到其他自定义 chain。

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px;
box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; orphans: 4; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: Lexend, Helvetica, SourceCodePro, NotoSansSC; font-size: 16px;
p.span: 这种设计使框架具有强大的分支功能，使得管理员可以组织更大更复杂的网络规则。

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 698px; height: 1px; padding-top: 207px; margin-left: 3022px;

p.span: 在讨论

code.style: box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SourceCodePro, Consolas, Courier, NotoSansSC; vertical-align: initial; padding: 0.6px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgb(241, 241, 241); font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0px 2px;

p.span: table 和 匹配连接状态的时候，我们介绍了构建在 netfilter 之上的 连接跟踪（conntrack）系统。连接跟踪系统使得 iptables 基于连接上下文而不是单个包来做出规则判断， 给 iptables 提供了有状态操作的功能。

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
p.span: 连接跟踪在包进入协议栈之后很快（very soon）就开始工作了。在给包分配连接之前所做 的工作非常少，只有检查

code.style: box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SourceCodePro, Consolas, Courier, NotoSansSC; vertical-align: initial; padding: 0.6px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgb(241, 241, 241); font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0px 2px;

p.span: table 和一些基本的完整性检查。

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; line-height: inherit; margin: 0.5rem 0px; position: relative; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
p.span: 跟踪系统将包和已有的连接进行比较，如果包所属的连接已经存在就更新连接状态， 否则就创建一个新连接。如果

code.style: box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SourceCodePro, Consolas, Courier, NotoSansSC; vertical-align: initial; padding: 0.6px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgb(241, 241, 241); font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0px 2px;

p.span: table 的某个 chain 对包标记为目标是

code.style: box-sizing: border-box; font-family: SourceCodePro, Consolas, Courier, NotoSansSC; vertical-align: initial; padding: 0.6px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: rgb(241, 241, 241); font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0px 2px;

p.span: ， 那这个包会跳过连接跟踪系统。

box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px 0px 0px 0.5em; background: linear-gradient(rgb(0, 105, 255), rgb(0, 105, 255)) center bottom / 0px 0px no-repeat; color: rgb(138, 150, 181); text-decoration-line: none; border-bottom: none; transition: opacity 0.2s ease-in-out 0s, visibility 0s linear 0.2s; font-size: 0.85em; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;

h2.style: text-align: center; box-sizing: border-box; break-after: avoid-page; break-inside: avoid; orphans: 4; margin-top: 0.83em; margin-bottom: 0.83em; position: relative;

p.style: color: rgb(77, 91, 124); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: start;

h2.p: A “target” refers to the actions that are triggered when a packet meets the matching criteria of a rule. Targets are generally divided into two categories:

ul.style: color: rgb(77, 91, 124); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px 0px 1.7em; list-style-position: initial; list-style-image: initial; padding: 0px 0px 0px 2.5em; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: start;
ul.li:
Terminating targets
: Terminating targets perform an action which terminates evaluation within the chain and returns control to the
netfilter
hook. Depending on the return value provided, the hook might drop the packet or allow the packet to continue to the next stage of processing.

Non-terminating targets
: Non-terminating targets perform an action and continue evaluation within the chain. Although each chain must eventually pass back a final terminating decision, any number of non-terminating targets can be executed beforehand.

p.style: color: rgb(77, 91, 124); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: start;

h2.p: The availability of each target within rules will depend on context. For instance, the table and chain type might dictate the targets available. The extensions activated in the rule and the matching clauses can also affect the availability of targets.

h2.style: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; font-family: Epilogue, sans-serif; color: rgb(77, 91, 124);
box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; font-family: Epilogue, sans-serif; color: rgb(77, 91, 124);

a.style: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px; background: linear-gradient(rgb(0, 105, 255), rgb(0, 105, 255)) center bottom / 0px 0px no-repeat; text-decoration-line: none; border-bottom: none; transition: background 300ms ease-in-out 0s, color 300ms ease-in-out 0s;

box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px 0px 0px 0.5em; background: linear-gradient(rgb(0, 105, 255), rgb(0, 105, 255)) center bottom / 0px 0px no-repeat; color: rgb(138, 150, 181); text-decoration-line: none; border-bottom: none; transition: opacity 0.2s ease-in-out 0s, visibility 0s linear 0.2s; font-size: 0.85em; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;

h2.style: text-align: center; box-sizing: border-box; break-after: avoid-page; break-inside: avoid; orphans: 4; margin-top: 0.83em; margin-bottom: 0.83em; position: relative;

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5; color: rgb(77, 91, 124); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; orphans: 2; text-align: start;

h2.p:
There is also a special class of
non-terminating target
: the jump target. Jump targets are actions that result in evaluation moving to a different chain for additional processing. We’ve covered the built-in chains which are tied to the
netfilter
hooks that call them. However,
iptables
also allows administrators to create their own chains for organizational purposes.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5; color: rgb(77, 91, 124); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: start;

h2.p:
Rules can be placed in user-defined chains in the same way that they can be placed into built-in chains. The difference is that user-defined chains can only be reached by “jumping” to them from a rule (they are not registered with a
netfilter
hook themselves).

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5; color: rgb(77, 91, 124); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: start;

h2.p:
User-defined chains act as extensions of the chain which called them. For instance, in a user-defined chain, evaluation will pass back to the calling chain if the end of the rule list is reached or if a
RETURN
target is activated by a matching rule. Evaluation can also jump to additional user-defined chains.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5; color: rgb(77, 91, 124); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; orphans: 2; text-align: start;

h2.p: This construct allows for greater organization and provides the framework necessary for more robust branching.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5; orphans: 2; text-align: start;

font.span: iptables command manual: This specifies the target of the rule; i.e., what to do if the packet matches it. The target can be a user-defined chain (other than the one this rule is in), one of the special builtin targets which decide the fate of the packet immediately, or an extension.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0px; line-height: 1.5; orphans: 2; text-align: start;
